finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it handed to your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That crashed the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to just treat that as off.

The rest was genuine noise — deprecation warnings from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.) — safe to leave for now.
